name: Supabase Design System (supabase/supabase packages/ui + apps/design-system)
licence: Apache-2.0 (github.com/supabase/supabase, pushed 2026-10-08). Supabase name, logo and brand-green marks are trademarks, not covered. Copy-paste ownership model (shadcn/ui based).
bestFor: developer platforms, dashboards and data-grid heavy admin UI
docs and marketing for technical products
teams that want a themeable system driven by one hue knob
products that need both a compact app density and a roomier marketing density
avoidFor: brands needing an expressive display typeface or illustration-led identity
teams that cannot absorb two coexisting token generations (legacy HSL aliases plus new OKLCH) during migration
very large-type editorial layouts (scale tops at 46px marketing, 70px token)

families: Source Code Pro (--font-mono; code, 81 text nodes on home)
legacy studio stack: Circular, custom-font, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial

scale.role: text-sm (UI small, DS body copy, buttons small/medium)
text-lg / marketing body (token ratio gives 24.89px; measured 24px)
text-3xl (token only, not observed in use)
text-4xl (DS h1, marketing h3 desktop, marketing h1 mobile)

typography.notes: Line-heights are tokenised as ratios (calc(1.25 / .875), calc(1.5 / 1)...), producing the fractional px above. Base UI size is 13px (text-sm) in the dashboard, 15px on the DS site, 16px on marketing; the root --text-sm is .8125rem, so Tailwind's `text-sm` is 13px here, not 14. Body weight 450 is a custom variable-font step. Mobile: marketing h1 34/37.78 (from 46/46), h3 22/29.33 (from 34/37.78); inputs use text-base on mobile (md:text-sm) to avoid iOS zoom. Measured 2026-10-08 at 1440 and 390 on supabase.com, /design-system, /docs, /pricing; tokens read from packages/config/css/theme.css and apps/design-system root vars.

neutrals.inputs: --surface (canvas lightness), --chroma, --surface-hue, --foreground-lightness, --contrast (0-1), --elevation-step; every other neutral is an OKLCH expression of these
neutrals.dark: surface L 0.19, chroma 0.005 (background uses chroma*0.5 = 0.0025), hue 157.5 (same as spot), foreground L 0.95 (chroma 0.00275), elevation-step 0.025, contrast 0.5, muted-foreground level 0.8, tertiary-foreground level 0.65; measured body bg oklch(0.19 0.0025 157.5) = #131413, text #edefee
neutrals.light: surface L 0.995 (soft gray, headroom to brighten toward white), chroma 0, surface-hue-offset 180 (complementary tint, 337.5deg), foreground L 0.10, elevation-step 0.024 (higher = lighter, same direction as dark), contrast 0.53, muted level 0.65, tertiary level 0.5; measured body bg oklch(0.995 0 337.5) = #fdfdfd, text #030303
neutrals.elevation ratios: card = background + step*1, popover = +step*1.5, secondary = +step*2, tertiary/overlay = +step*3 (ratios 1, 1.5, 2, 3 shared by all themes)
neutrals.muted/accent/tertiary fills: foreground at alpha computed to match the same lightness delta (muted = e1, accent = e2, tertiary = e3), so they composite on any plate
neutrals.field fills: --field = black at alpha 0.015 light / 0.12 dark (sunk text entry); --control-raised = white at muted-alpha*0.65 (raised chooser)
neutrals.legacy scales: Radix colors v0.1.9 as --colors-{name}-{light|dark}-{100..1200} and alpha twins in HSL channels (gray, slate plus tomato..gold etc.); surface-75/100/200/300 aliases remap onto card/muted/secondary

accents.primary (ink): dark oklch(0.76 0.15 157.5) ~ #4acd8b; light oklch(0.525 0.12 157.5) ~ #0e7e4e; hover shifts lightness only (+0.04 * sign of tone-span)
accents.primary-solid (button plate): dark oklch(0.43627 0.11 157.5) ~ #006338 with foreground oklch(0.95 0.00275 h); light = primary
accents.primary-bright (rings, selected chrome): oklch(from primary max(l,0.7) max(c,0.15) h); ring = primary-bright at 55% alpha
accents.brand-default (fixed identity green): hsl(153.1 60.2% 52.7%) dark, hsl(152.9 60% 52.9%) light; measured logo/code bg rgb(63,207,142) = #3fcf8e; does not follow primary hue
accents.legacy stepped scales: brand/warning/destructive/secondary 200,300,400,500,default,600 as per-theme literals (e.g. dark brand-600 hsl(154.9 59.5% 70%), light brand-600 hsl(156.5 86.5% 26.1%))

semantic.warning: oklch(L 0.14 hue) hue clamp(65, 75+pull, 95); L 0.80 dark / 0.55 light (light hue 58)
semantic.info: violet hue clamp(272, 288+pull, 302); L 0.70 dark / 0.54 light
semantic.shared chroma: --expressive-chroma 0.14 constant, deliberately not tied to the neutral chroma knob so status stays legible when brand is dialled to grayscale
semantic.hue pull: --status-hue-pull 0.15 toward the brand hue, clamped to keep warning amber, destructive red, info violet
semantic.on-fill foreground: oklch(from fill clamp(0.12, (0.62 - l)*100, 0.99) c*0.08 h): hard flip at L 0.62
semantic.approx hex: dark warning #f2af48, destructive #b54a46, info #9b8ff0; light warning #ac5800, destructive #ab413e, info #6c5eba

color.darkMode: Two real themes plus system. Dark and light are separate literal sets feeding one OKLCH derivation (semantic.css). Light surface hue is offset 180deg from the spot hue; dark uses the same hue as spot. Dark separates bright ink (--primary, L .76) from a deeper button plate (--primary-solid, L .436) so buttons do not read lime; light collapses ink and plate into one green. Elevation direction is unified (higher = lighter) in both modes. Light foreground is L .10, dark L .95 (both below pure black/white). Marketing site follows prefers-color-scheme (measured: dark bg oklch(0.19 0.0025 157.5), light bg oklch(0.995 0 337.5)).
color.contrastNotes: Computed from the stated OKLCH values (sRGB conversion, WCAG ratio) 2026-10-08: light fg/bg 20.28:1; light muted-foreground (L .52065) on bg 5.40:1; light primary ink on bg 5.02:1; light primary-foreground on primary plate 4.96:1; dark fg/bg 15.99:1; dark primary ink on bg 9.14:1; dark primary-solid-foreground on plate 6.40:1. Docs claim text-primary meets WCAG AA for normal text on app surfaces in both modes; computed values agree. Contrast knob 0-1 re-scales foreground, muted fg and border alpha globally (floor 0.9 for text, 0.05 for borders).

spacing.base: 4px (Tailwind v4 --spacing .25rem); legacy tokens --spacing-scale 2px and --sizing-scale 1.5px. Notes: Legacy tokens: xs 4, sm 8, md 16, lg 32, xl 64, xxl 128; card padding var(--card-padding-x) 1rem, md 1.5rem; --spacing-content 21px; --width-listbox 320px; --breakpoint-xs 480px; --content-width-screen-xl 1128px; --container-site 128rem. Marketing container measured 1088px (x=176..1264) at 1440. Data grid: row height 28px (--datatable-rowheight), header icon 16px. Sizing scale 1.5px: xs 4, sm 6, md 9, lg 13.5, xl 20.25.

radius.rule: Tailwind-v4 theme: xs 2px, sm 4px, md 6px (default control radius), lg 8px, xl 12px, 2xl 16px; --radius-panel 6px; --radius-item = md - 2px (nested items concentric with their panel). Legacy --borderradius-xs/sm/lg/xl = 2/4/8/16, tableheader 4. Badges and chips are pills. Measured on marketing the radii are about 1.333x of this scale (5.33, 10.67, 21.33px; buttons 8.86-9.29px), cause inferred to be a marketing radius multiplier; DS site buttons measure 6px (md) and inputs 8px.

shadows: none by default: --button-shadow-opacity/-drop/-raised/-default are all empty at rest (measured box-shadow all transparent)
--drop-shadow-xs 0 1px 1px #0000000d (only declared shadow in the DS theme)
focus: ring-2 ring-ring (primary-bright at 55%) with ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background; inset variant outline 2px offset -2px for table rows
inset highlight on dark marketing chips: inset rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 0 0 0 1px
depth.borders: Depth is built from alpha borders and lightness steps (see elevation ratios), not shadows. Border opacity scales with the contrast knob. Overlay border stronger than control border; status borders at 30% alpha.
depth.blur: unknown (backdrop blur not measured on DS; marketing header blur not extracted)

easings: ease (opacity 400ms x2821 reveal on marketing, 600ms x60)
motion.notes: --default-transition-duration .15s. Marketing page applies a 400ms opacity fade to about 2800 elements (scroll/entrance reveal). Focus indicators are deliberately excluded from transition lists so they appear instantly (focus-inset). prefers-reduced-motion behaviour not verified.

modes: compact studio/dashboard (13px text, 26-34px controls, 28px grid rows)

list: UI patterns (10): charts, connect-interstitials, empty-states, forms, introduction, layout, markdown, modality, navigation, tables
components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Documented and coded: button variants default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link x sizes default/sm/lg/icon (shadcn layer) plus legacy tiny..xlarge with loading, icon, iconRight; hover tokens for primary, primary-solid, warning, destructive via --*-hover (lightness delta 0.04); focus-visible ring recipe (focus-ring and focus-inset) shared by all controls; disabled = opacity .5, pointer-events none, with focusableWhenDisabled for discoverable unavailable actions; input has hover border, focus border, read-only text colour, aria-invalid bg/border/hover/focus states, disabled text; badge variants default/warning/success/destructive/secondary. Per-component tests (vitest) exist for accordion, alert-dialog, sheet, tabs, toggle(-group).

tokenArchitecture: Layered, all CSS custom properties, Tailwind v4 @theme-mapped: (0) primitives: Radix scales --colors-{hue}-{light|dark}-{100..1200} (+alpha), spacing, sizing, radius, icon sizes in global.css (exported from Figma through packages/ui/internals/tokens); (1) inputs per theme: --hue/--primary-hue, --surface-hue-offset, --chroma, --surface, --foreground-lightness, --contrast, --elevation-step, --field-alpha, stepped literals (brand/warning/destructive/secondary 200-600); (2) semantic derivation in semantic.css via OKLCH relative-colour syntax: --background, --foreground, --card, --popover, --primary(-solid/-bright/-foreground/-hover), --secondary, --tertiary, --muted, --accent, --field, --control, --warning, --destructive, --info, --border, --input, --ring; (3) compat.css maps legacy names (--foreground-light, --background-surface-100, --border-strong, --sidebar-*) onto (2) so un-migrated code keeps resolving; (4) Tailwind utilities (bg-surface-100, text-foreground-light, border-strong, focus-ring). Naming is by role not by value; shorthands (text-muted = text-foreground-muted) avoid double typing.
distinctiveness: One hue knob (--primary-hue) re-colours ink, button plate, focus ring and selected controls while the fixed brand green stays separate; every semantic colour is derived in OKLCH from a handful of inputs including a global contrast knob; status colours share one chroma and clamp their hues so they stay recognisable under any brand hue; ink-vs-plate split (bright green text, deep green button) in dark; weight-450 Inter plus Manrope headings; documentation lives in the same repo as the components, with copywriting, accessibility and icon rules.
weaknesses: two token generations coexist (HSL channel scales and OKLCH semantics) bridged by a compat file; their own doc says the Brand scale is not uniform and brand-200 in dark themes is bad
two sizing systems (shadcn 36/40/44px vs legacy 26/34/38/42/50px) and two radius multipliers (DS 6/8px vs marketing about 8.9-10.7px)
no shadow language (button shadow tokens are empty), so floating layers rely on borders and lightness only; elevation reads weak in light mode
base text is 13px in the dashboard; small for general consumer audiences
documentation mixes Tailwind class names with tokens; the docs say studio, www and docs use different background utilities
takeaways: Drive all semantic colour from 5-7 inputs (hue, chroma, surface lightness, foreground lightness, contrast, elevation step, field alpha) using OKLCH relative colour so a theme is a short file
Split accent into ink (small readable text), plate (button fill), bright (focus ring, selected) and a fixed brand colour; each has its own contrast job
Define one shared contrast knob (0-1) that scales foreground, muted foreground and border alpha together
Give status colours one shared chroma and clamp their hues to perceptual categories so they survive any brand hue; flip on-colour text at L 0.62
Use elevation ratios (1, 1.5, 2, 3) times a signed step so 'higher = lighter' holds in both modes
Write down the focus ring as two recipes (offset ring for controls, inset outline for dense rows) and exclude outline from transitions so focus appears instantly
Document 'focusable when disabled' for unavailable actions that need an explanation
Ship a compat alias file when migrating tokens and delete entries as consumers move; mark it as temporary
Treat copywriting (verbs not nouns, sentence case, no exclamation marks, no marketing words) as part of the design system
